description: GEO-02A MapLibre renderer qualification: design challenge and exact-diff review

remote_egress.instructions: The renderer could contact an unqualified remote tile/style/glyph/sprite/CDN/worker origin, or a later provider could be smuggled into GEO-02A without a separate admission.

criteria.true: Some renderer path permits unqualified remote egress
criteria.false: GEO-02A has zero remote renderer origins and uses same-origin worker plus inline empty style only

fallback_failure.instructions: A WebGL2/GPU/renderer initialization failure could crash or hide the care-discovery experience instead of degrading to the complete accessible list.

criteria.true: A renderer failure can remove or block the list experience
criteria.false: All renderer failures degrade explicitly while the independent accessible list remains usable

lifecycle_leak.instructions: The client renderer could create duplicate maps/workers/listeners across re-renders or fail to call map.remove() on unmount.

criteria.true: Renderer lifecycle can leak or duplicate resources
criteria.false: Initialization is single-owner and cleanup deterministically removes the map

accessibility_regression.instructions: MapLibre could become the only usable interface, trap keyboard users, remove RTL semantics, or add map-only actions with no list/text equivalent.

criteria.true: The renderer creates an accessibility/localization regression
criteria.false: The map is supplementary, RTL/list/keyboard fallbacks remain intact, and no map-only required action is introduced

dependency_integrity.instructions: MapLibre could be floating/unreleased, have unrecorded license/notice obligations, or be copied/forked instead of using the exact released dependency and lockfile inventory.

criteria.true: Dependency provenance or license/inventory is incomplete
criteria.false: Exact released version, license/notices and lockfile inventory are recorded and renderer source is not copied

bundle_unbounded.instructions: The renderer could add an unmeasured or unenforced JS/CSS/worker footprint to the patient web bundle.

criteria.true: No measured baseline/ceiling protects the renderer footprint
criteria.false: Exact installed artifacts are measured and an explicit budget is tested

untested_requirement.instructions: A GEO-02A handoff requirement (init, no-map fallback, RTL, keyboard/list, CSP/network allowlist, WebGL fallback, bundle budget, cleanup/unmount) lacks deterministic qualification coverage.

criteria.true: At least one required behavior is untested
criteria.false: Every required behavior has deterministic qualification coverage
